items.ig_caption:
How AI agents get hijacked. 🤖

The attack path (OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications):
→ Poisoned input: a web page or a malicious MCP server feeds the agent hidden instructions (ASI01 goal hijack, ASI04 supply chain)
→ The agent now uses your connected tools in ways nobody intended (ASI02 tool misuse)
→ With credentials wider than the task, it acts with your access (ASI03 privilege abuse)

The fixes, in order:
→ Separate trusted instructions from untrusted content
→ Allowlist vetted MCP servers only
→ Authorise every tool call and validate its parameters
→ Scope credentials per task, just in time

Those are 4 of the 10. The rest: unexpected code execution, memory poisoning, insecure agent-to-agent messages, cascading failures, human trust exploitation and rogue agents.
